Electromagnetic compatibility, refers to the ability of an electrical device to work satisfactorily in its electromagnetic environment without adversely influencing the surrounding devices, or being influenced by them.
It is an abbreviation for flame resistant 4, is a type of material used for making a printed circuit board (PCB). It describes the board itself with no copper covering.

Input/output buffer information specification is a behavioral-modeling specification. It is a standard for describing the analog behavior of the buffers of a digital device using plain ASCII text formatted data.
It is is a specialized communication interface targeting single, dual or quad SPI flash memories.
Signal integrity, denotes the correct timing and quality of the signal.
